reasons: CS4261 is offered only in Sem 1, but Y4S1 is an exchange semester with no modules and no later Sem 1 remains.
CS2101 must be completed before CS4248, but after the Y4S1 exchange only Y4S2 remains.
CS4243 is fixed in semester 8, so CS4248 cannot be placed after CS2101 in a later semester.
